items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I would sing Erskine Hawkins’s Tuxedo Junction. I know that trumpet solo to this day, by Dud Bascomb.

ctx.x: Okay. So you scatted them, in a sense.

Yeah, I would scat them. That’s why it was easier for me to put words to things later on, because I had been doing that. I would sing Erskine Hawkins’s Tuxedo Junction. I know that trumpet solo to this day, by Dud Bascomb. [Hendricks scat-sings the whole solo.] I love that solo. That’s one of the great solos of all time.
It stuck with you all of these years.
